examples.chinese: 國安發燒了，不能來上課，我有點兒擔心他。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè, wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā.
examples.english: Guo'an has a fever and cannot come to class; I am a little worried about him.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？
examples.pinyin: Lǐ tàitai dānxīn háizi yīnwèi chī de tài shǎo, zhǎng bù gāo, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo zhǔyì?
examples.english: Mrs. Li is worried that her child won't grow tall because he eats too little. Do you have any good ideas?

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒了，不過不必太擔心，只要戴上口罩、別去人多的地方就行了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào le, bùguò bùbì tài dānxīn, zhǐyào dài shàng kǒuzhào, bié qù rén duō de dìfāng jiù xíng le.
examples.english: Many people have caught colds recently, but you don't need to worry too much; as long as you wear a mask and don't go to crowded places, it's all right.

examples.chinese:
小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。
孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ.
Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english:
Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired.
There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

items.wordHook: 擔心 means to worry: 擔(bear) + 心(heart) → carrying a burden on your heart.

examples.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
examples.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese:
李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。
今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo.
Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english:
Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good.
Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì de wēndù yàoshi kòngzhì de gānghǎo, bùdàn duì jiànkāng hǎo, yě néng shěng diǎnr diànfèi.
examples.english: If the air conditioner's temperature is controlled to be just right, it is not only good for health but also saves a bit on electricity bills.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 這本小說很有意思，值得推薦。雖然我排隊排了一個小時才買到跨年演唱會的票，可是很值得。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō hěn yǒu yìsi, zhídé tuījiàn. Suīrán wǒ páiduì pái le yí ge xiǎoshí cái mǎi dào kuànián yǎnchànghuì de piào, kěshì hěn zhídé.
examples.english: This novel is very interesting and worth recommending. Although I waited in line for an hour before I got tickets to the New Year's Eve concert, it was very worth it.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese:
這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。
老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān.
Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english:
This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting.
The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese:
許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。
你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin:
Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn.
Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english:
Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient.
There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 那位博士在本次會議中所提到的問題，值得我們進一步研究。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi bóshì zài běn cì huìyì zhōng suǒ tí dào de wèntí, zhídé wǒmen jìnyībù yánjiū.
examples.english: The problems that that PhD mentioned in this conference are worth our further study.

examples.chinese:
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。
每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin:
Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de.
Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english:
The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money.
Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 用人類的角度去看大自然， 就看不出大自然的本來價值。
examples.pinyin: Yòng rénlèi de jiǎodù qù kàn dàzìrán, jiù kàn bù chū dàzìrán de běnlái jiàzhí.
examples.english: Looking at nature from a human perspective, you cannot see nature's original value.

examples.chinese: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jìhuà zhǐ zhēnduì shǎo bùfèn qūyù shíyàn, cānkǎo jiàzhí bù gāo.
examples.english: This research project only conducts experiments in a small number of areas, so its reference value is not high.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子空間小，位置離市區又遠，所以價值三百萬而已。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi kōngjiān xiǎo, wèizhì lí shìqū yòu yuǎn, suǒyǐ jiàzhí sānbǎi wàn éryǐ.
examples.english: This house has little space and is far from the city center, so it is worth only three million.

items.wordHook: Combining 價(price) and 值(price): 價值 means value.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

items.wordHook: Combining 使(cause) and 得(get): 使得 means make, to cause.

examples.chinese: 這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn hěn jí, qǐng nǐ xiàbān yǐqián chuánzhēn gěi duìfāng gōngsī.
examples.english: This document is very urgent; please fax it to the other company before you get off work.

examples.chinese: 有張紙卡在傳真機裡，你拿得出來嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu zhāng zhǐ kǎ zài chuánzhēnjī lǐ, nǐ ná de chūlái ma?
examples.english: There's a piece of paper stuck in the fax machine; can you get it out?

examples.chinese: 每個人都有煩惱，如果能好好處理，就能從過程中得到經驗。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu fánnǎo, rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo chǔlǐ, jiù néng cóng guòchéng zhōng dédào jīngyàn.
examples.english: Everyone has worries; if you can handle them well, you can gain experience from the process.

examples.chinese: 時間有時能消除煩惱，不能解決的事就暫時放在一邊吧。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān yǒu shí néng xiāochú fánnǎo, bù néng jiějué de shì jiù zànshí fàng zài yìbiān ba.
examples.english: Time can sometimes eliminate worries; for things that can't be solved, just put them aside for the time being.

examples.chinese: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu, chāoguò gèrén xūqiú de xiāofèi, què zhǐ huì dàilái fánnǎo.
examples.english: Shopping is a kind of enjoyment, but spending that exceeds personal needs only brings worries.

examples.chinese: 在學習新知識的過程中，總是會有開心與煩惱的時候。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí xīn zhīshì de guòchéng zhōng, zǒngshì huì yǒu kāixīn yǔ fánnǎo de shíhou.
examples.english: In the process of learning new knowledge, there will always be times of happiness and worry.

examples.chinese: 他很煩惱，不知道畢業以後要找什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn fánnǎo, bù zhīdào bìyè yǐhòu yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: He is very worried, not knowing what job to look for after graduation.

examples.chinese: 你在外面花錢吃不健康的食物，還不如自己在家煮。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài wàimiàn huāqián chī bù jiànkāng de shíwù, hái bùrú zìjǐ zài jiā zhǔ.
examples.english: You spend money eating unhealthy food outside; you'd be better off cooking at home yourself.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
examples.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

examples.chinese: 現代人生活忙碌，就算是好友也偶然才碰面聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén shēnghuó mánglù, jiùsuàn shì hǎoyǒu yě ǒurán cái pèngmiàn liáoliao.
examples.english: Modern people are busy with life; even good friends only meet occasionally to chat.

examples.chinese: 根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Huárén mínjiān de shuōfǎ, guònián shí rúguǒ shōudào hóngbāo, zhěng nián jiù huì yǒu hǎoyùnqi.
examples.english: According to Chinese folk sayings, if you receive a red envelope during the New Year, you will have good luck for the whole year.

examples.chinese: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào wǒ guó guānfāng guīdìng, mínjiān bànlǐ huánbǎo huódòng kě xiàng guānfāng shēnqǐng jīngfèi.
examples.english: According to our country's official regulations, when non-governmental organizations hold environmental activities, they can apply to the government for funding.

examples.chinese: 處理老房屋的問題，有時比重新建築一棟房子還要困難。
examples.pinyin: Chǔlǐ lǎo fángwū de wèntí, yǒushí bǐ chóngxīn jiànzhù yī dòng fángzi hái yào kùnnán.
examples.english: Dealing with the problems of old houses is sometimes even more difficult than building a house anew.

items.wordHook: Combining 正(right now) and 確(certain): 正確 means correct.
Combining 神(god) and 祕(secret): 神祕 means mysterious.
